items.reason: Inclusion: 'high-grade glioma, defined as WHO (2021) Central Nervous System Tumor Classification grade 3 or 4 gliomas; or primary central nervous system lymphoma'. Grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named in the counted fields, which is R7's case. The trial still fails S6 (CD70 CAR-T), so only the exclusion reason changes (S6 excluded_intervention_type instead of S5 not_glioblastoma).
The R7 inclusion cites 'WHO (2021) Central Nervous System Tumor Classification grade 3 or 4 gliomas', so cns5 applies by the manual's tie-break (D31-B4).

note: Included under D30-R7 (grade 3 or 4 glioma, no IDH requirement, glioblastoma not named) with cns5_terminology cns5 (D31-B4). PCNSL is also eligible, but D31-B15 needs GBM named, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named stands. Fails S6 (CD70 CAR-T, excluded_intervention_type).
